[quote=ekpatanus;60682310]Official Statement of the Kingdom of Ekpatanus  
Date: 9 October 2026

After more than seventy-two hours have passed without a coherent response from the Anti-Principalist government of Tallisland and its allies regarding the proposal for a temporary ceasefire and the commencement of negotiations on the future of Tallisland, the Kingdom of Ekpatanus hereby formally announces the initiation of temporary political and economic sanctions against the Second Republic of Flousech, the Anti-Principalist government of Tallisland, and Thýven, effective as of today, 9 October 2026.  

The Kingdom of Ekpatanus continues to support the path of diplomacy and the opening of negotiations. Should the conflict in Tallisland come to an end and a mutually acceptable resolution be reached by both parties, the Kingdom of Ekpatanus will lift these sanctions and restore relations to their normal state.

[quote=lavinsworth_united_islands;60678801][b]The ULR raises concerns around the EDU's and Daesun's expanding cooperation[/b]

Recently, the Elseyran Defense Union (EDU) accepted Daesun as an associate member into the Union, expanding the earlier agreement the nation had with the Neue Republik. The acceptance has given Daesun preferred terms in the EDU such as lowered tariffs and has even allowed Daesun to access the union's emergency fund, giving the large nation something to lean on in the case it is hit with a crisis. These are all relatively good pieces of news for the nation, the real attention of Lavia has been put on the other parts of the agreement. 

Lavia recently signed a trade and exchange deal with Daesun, allowing them to purchase and sell multiple things to us. Chief among these are proprietary nuclear energy and research technologies, weapons, armored vehicles, military aircraft, shipbuilding techniques, and very importantly, plutonium. The Kianzhoun nation becoming an associate member with the EDU also include Daesun in joint projects such as nuclear energy research as well as integrating Daesun's military further towards the EDU standard. Not only does this potentially expose critical Lavian technologies planned to be sent to Daesun to the prying eyes of the EDU, an alliance which seems to see itself more and more as the international police, challenging our THEP allies while at it, as well as supporting the oppressive Tallislandic government contrary to their own stated mission.

As of recent, many experts who have already been sent to Daesun have been ordered to stop working, and important technologies which were bound for the nation now sit idle in port, waiting for a decision to be made. The Lavian government has sent an official complaint to the Daesunite government, requesting a rewrite to the recent trade deal which would involve the Directorate of International Intelligence (DII) overlooking all usage, transportation, storage and study of proprietary technologies deemed critical to Lavian security, as well as guarantees that Daesun would not share any information about the technologies, military arms and vehicles agreed bought under the agreement with the EDU, and they will not provide the union any nuclear material purchased from Lavia in any way. While consumer goods and resources remain in trade, the holding of experts and tech from Daesun holds them to either agree to the wanted rewrite or loose anticipated critical technologies and may further lose entire parts of the deal.

Finally, Daesun's military bases across the ULR will be bared from access to all EDU troops and vehicles, announced by the Military Command of the Republic. Not posing an immediate issue, this can become a hot piece of contention as Daesun integrates further with the EDU, requiring the nation to station potentially older equipment on such bases to comply with such requirements as they replace their vehicles and weaponry to comply with the union's own military requirements. Daesun has shown they are willing to work with Lavia, but the nation waits to see if they will accept Lavia's demands, or look to the EDU to fill the withheld technologies.

[spoiler=[b]An account of a certain civil war survivor[/b]][b][pre]An account of a certain civil war survivor[/pre][/b]

[pre]Every single one of us has been condemned to die. We lived in this land a thousand years and have suffered many conquerors. If it is today at the hands of the Benirists or tomorrow the Nationalists there is no difference. We will all be dead. Last night I was walking down the road past the village with my wife Leinali and we saw smoke. We thought the neighbor had been burning garbage again and walked away. He always burned dried leaves that irritated the eyes so we did not want to be there. My wife went to get food from the old lady towards the main road when the smoke became fire and we paused for a moment to look at what was happening. We heard a loud sound and the noise of falling trees and a man yelled for us to run but did not know where to run. I ran into the hut. The white soldiers told us to stay put when the sounds become loud but Leinali ran out. I called out to her but I was pushed by something very powerful. I tried to look up and saw the Sun out of the Sun. Two Suns! I screamed, two Suns! They emerged out of the sky and became total light. I felt my entire body burning up like I was set on fire, but then the Sun fell asleep and I was thrown out of the hut. Sticks and rocks fell on me and there was blood. I thought I lost my arm but it was just deeply cut so I got up and looked for my wife. My arm dragged into the ground and bled but I did not feel anything. I called out to Leinali's name for a few seconds and saw carnage. Every hut had been destroyed. Even new government buildings with their concrete was destroyed. I fell to the ground and slept for a while. I lost too much blood. When I awoke, I was lying on an open street surrounded by other wounded men. The ground had split open beneath me. Chunks of rocks were everywhere. I walked past an old man who begged me to help his son who had been trapped under rubble but my arm was useless. His son was already dead but the old man wanted to get the body. I could not do anything so I walked away and looked for Leinali but I could not find her. At some point I collapsed and was carried by a good man to a field clinic. I woke up in a filthy bed stained by the other dead. It smelled of rust. I am trying to understand what happened but I cannot think right now. I cannot feel. The doctors sewed my arm back together and told me to rest but I could not rest. My eyes feel blurry and I cannot rest, I keep breathing too quickly. My wife is missing and I have not heard from her for days. I believe it is time to accept the worst and maybe she and I will meet again in a place far from here.[/pre][/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]QASIC autumn phase offensive[/b]][b]QASIC autumn phase offensive[/b]

It was now September.

QASIC has triumphed everywhere. In the karst plateau of the southwest and in the lush tall grasses of the northern plains or in the sprawling concrete jungles of Astan and the ominous black fields of Kuwalkti, the sacred cause of the people's revolution has won everywhere. Now, the enemy has nothing left to do but to lose.

First, the case of Haru Arono's desperate last stand against the odds. While it was true that the mad dash towards Kuwalkti was now much more lightly defended than before, with Horano Benir and his Conciliar Guard having moved into Astan, David Cyriacus's Democratic Legion and Pax International still occupied the airbase all this time, having been in use since the beginning of the QASIC summer phase offensive as the [i]de facto[/i] headquarters of QASICAIR.

Five battalion-level commands, bereft of air cover, would not suffice to challenge the Democratic forces at this point in time, where the nation has effectively consolidated itself into a network of well-armed, well-trained soviets simply eager to expedite the transition back to a civilian way of life. However, with the Astanirans exhausted by the constant, meaningless slaughter of their fellow countrymen, David Cyriacus and Horano Benir would accept integrating a simple defensive strategy to push the Free forces back into their territory.

Concerning the matter of the Free army drones, Benir would rule out QASIC suggestions of order anti-cluser SAMs against the enemy, instead asking QASIC to deploy truck-mounted jammers towards the frontline to immediately throw Arono's FPV drones out of the sky and render their ground forces blind for the duration of the battle. Due to miscommunication however, the jammers would also take out QASIC's own FPV drones in the general area, forcing them to rely on aircraft and recon vehicles to keep track of enemy forces.

With the Democratic frontlines asked to simply hold out and launch artillery strikes against the Free forces, Haru Benir would ask Cyriacus to use his own men to resolve the issue as bloodlessly as possible. After some deliberation, Cyriacus would suggest that "... a great forcing from the dark" will be necessary to bring the bloodshed to a close.

Freya Moran's Eureka Group had performed excellently in Operation Xuanwu. Now, placed inside several helicopters and APCs, these same SummitONE special forces would be ordered to discreetly insert north into the Free enclave and tasked with 1) eliminating local police units and guard troops patrolling the [i]de facto[/i] Free capital 2) destroying powerlines, reserve battery systems, and gas stations to limit the enemy's ability to respond and 3) take control of the Free Zone's government palaces, thereby capturing the Arono cabinet and decisively decapitating the Free Army's command structure.

While this autumn phase of the QASIC offensive would begin, out in the Bay of Astanir QASICOCEAN began its own final campaign.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Operation Kawo Penah[/b]][b]Operation Kawo Penah[/b]

[list][sub]"SOLDIERS OF GOD AND MAN: This last operation is to be named the [i]Kawo Penah[/i], or "the end", which shall clue you in on its purpose. There is blood here in the Yellow Bay and across the Astaniran karst and on the great cities and plains, but the peace is not yet. Soldiers, the city of God waits for us! Soon, we are to commence the headlong journey to shed heroic blood on the last enemy that shall be destroyed, who have committed the most horrible atrocities against the human race. [u]TO WHAT LENGTHS SHALL WE DARE TO AVENGE[/u]?"[/sub]

[list][sub][i]Final general bulletin aboard the SNS Civitas Dei, authored by Admiral Caio Graci.[/i][/sub][/list][/list]

With the Restorationists expected to run out of supplies very soon, QASIC now needed to deal with the last real fighting force still present on Astaniran soil. The United Democratic Forces as they were called had up until this time barricaded itself within the Southern Islands, a six-island archipelagic polity that historically affiliated itself closer with the continent of Kianzhou than with Shamat. With foreign support for the People's Republic of Astanir coming in from Qianxun, Sanguivallis, Thyven, Thrysmora, and Western View, never mind indirect aid being funnelled in via Hydronia, the time was now right to dismantle the last vestiges of division in the nation and to bring peace and tranquility to a nation so brutally sacrificed by the greed of so few.

Under the operation name [i]Kawo Penah[/i] meaning "The End" or "The Totality", Horano Benir would authorize QASIC to begin the process of eliminating the "pseudo-humanitarian zone" currently occupied by UDF forces, better known in common QASIC parlance as the "Fascist Zone". Because of the islands' disjointed nature, Kawo Penah would really be four separate military operations only nominally unified under that name. Because the Southern Islands possessed Kianzhou names that were difficult for the Astanirans to pronounce, they would each be given provisional Vespurian names instead for ease of communication. From right to left, these landmasses would be: Amos Island, Bonsor Island, the Cable Islands, and the Deller Islands, alphabetically named after various Pax International personnel who helped eradicate the Llyndorran flu in Astan.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Amos Island[/b]][b]Battle of Amos Island[/b]

The first on the list of island chains to conquer was Amos Island, the UDF's easternmost territorial conquest. At roughly 225 square kilometers, Amos Island was tied with Cable Superior as the second-largest of the UDF islands, with a roughly rounded shape. It was on this island that the UDF, emboldened by the sight of Daesunic armed forces, first initiated its ruthless genocide of the Argossian minority community, and installing in their place pseudo-humanitarian zones to shield itself from international scrutiny.

At around 7,000 kilometers away from the nearest Democratic port at Lohak, actually getting to the islands would require a feat of logistics which QASICOCEAN was now prepared to endure in order to end the civil war and see the mothers and fathers of the nation refocus their attentions toward burying their daughters and sons.

Of the roughly 77 ships that QASICOCEAN would field for Kawo Penah, only around a third would be capable of undertaking the arduous blue water journey to the UDF islands. Quite unsurprisingly, the Sanguinian and Qianxun Navies would contribute the most tonnage to this operation, with the SNS [i]Civitas Dei [/i]and the QNS [i]Du Jiao[/i], [i]Tongyi[/i], and [i]Weizhu [/i]operating together as an [i]ad hoc[/i] carrier strike force. Astanir would also send its two aging battleships, the [i]Karnoua [/i]and the [i]Luakai[/i], who've seen been refitted with missile platforms and smart shell systems following a deal with the Lavians shortly after Operation Haiyan.

On the 10th of September 2025, supreme naval commander Caio Graci would authorize the beginning of Operation Kawo Penah, selecting for this purpose Task Group 1 ([i]Civitas Dei [/i]aircraft carrier; [i]Gloriosus [/i]amphibious transport dock), Task Group 2 ([i]Radiante[/i], [i]Instancabile [/i]guided missile frigates; [i]Cinghiale[/i], [i]Farfalla[/i], [i]Prominenza [/i]auxiliary cruisers), and Task Group 7 ([i]Karnoua[/i], [i]Luakai [/i]fast battleships) to participate in the campaign, for a total of 9 blue water ships specifically assigned to direct naval combat. Task Group 4 is to also join the operation in support to keep QASICOCEAN's fleet well-supplied during the journey.

What little lessons the QASICOCEAN had learned from their brutal turkey shoot in the Battle of Yellow Bay would be repeated here, with the [i]Gloriosus[/i]-class amphibious transport dock conducting drills with its four Civetta ECO-5 ASW helicopters to ensure that all times, QASICOCEAN forces would remain at the top of their game against the UDF/Daesunians, while sonobuoys would also be prepared to help the force guard against any submarines that the Daesunians may have patrolling the waters.

The entire journey from Port Lohak to Amos Island is expected to take roughly a day or two, with the entire force carrying a total of about 2,200 across all Task Groups. Additionally, a number of merchant vessels would be repurposed by QASIC to serve as troop transports for an additional 3,000 men for this endeavor.

Overall, the plan for Amos Island was simple. Reach the islands, engage and destroy the enemy's naval capabilities at the furthest range possible with their missiles; drones systems; and aircraft, then perpetuate a shock and awe campaign by blocking the island on all sides, destroying its defenses and supplies, then hopefully forcing its eventual surrender. QASIC would rule out the possibility of an amphibious landing, believing such endeavor to be suicidal, and would hope that the Daesunians would not risk a direct battle against the odds.

Though QASICOCEAN would be confident in victory, some elements of the High Committee would express caution in the use of the two aging fast battleships, the [i]Karnoua [/i]and the [i]Luakai[/i], who had only very recently been modernized to fit a set of six missile launch platforms and several hundred new "smart shells", both of which remained unproven in actual battle. Thus, the two ships would remain in the rear of the formation, expected to only contributed at the later stages of the battle as coastal battery against the UDF's targets.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Bonsor Island[/b]][b]Battle of Bonsor Island[/b]

Around a thousand kilometers out from Amos Island was a roughly 675 square kilometer island, provisionally named in QASIC databases as Bonsor Island. As the largest landmass in the Fascist Zone, the QASIC High Committee would infer Bonsor's general area to be the site of the worst atrocities committed by UDF/Daesunian forces. Many would also suspect it to be the main naval base of the Mugunghwa Shield, known to QASIC as the only source of naval power projection that the UDF/Daesunians have in the general region.

In accordance with fragmentary intelligence from the Argossians and the Nordiheimians, QASICOCEAN had strong reason to believe that Bonsor Island was the site of missile launch bays, intense AA systems, naval batteries, and other coastal defenses, but fairly limited supplies not least due to the immense distance that the Daesunians were forced to repeatedly traverse en route to a group of islands that, quite frankly, had very limited capabilities in industrialization, especially when compared to the Mainland which had by now obtained some degree of self-sufficiency.

Task Group 5 ([i]Du Jiao[/i], [i]Tongyi[/i], [i]Weizhu [/i]amphibious assault ships) is to serve as the primary strike force for this mission, to be guarded by elements of Task Group 8 ([i]Wharai[/i], [i]Awaiki [/i]light cruisers) and elements of Task Group 9 ([i]Taraya[/i], [i]Lono[/i], [i]Havikalo[/i], [i]Faozai[/i] guided missile frigates).

Yun Caibo would serve as the supreme commander of this flotilla, and would be ordered to trail behind Caio Graci's flotilla bound for Amos Island, tasked simply with acting as a supporting force that, on contact, is to break off and head for Bonsor Island to locate and destroy its ports, supply stations, and garrisons.[/spoiler]
